debit.notes: 24x7. The debit-cards page's card-loss instruction is to report immediately to the J&K Bank 24x7 Personalised Helpdesk — helpdesk@jkbmail.com, +91-194-2481936, 2481953 / Toll Free Number 1800-890-2922 — or the nearest Business Unit; it also states 'You can block your Card and ask for a replacement through J&K Bank Mobile App or by calling up the call-center on 1800-890-2122 / +91-194-2482463, 2486424'. Overseas callers: Inbound International Voice Services +91 194 2713434, +91 194 2713435 & +91 194 2481936 (contact page). The grievance page adds online fraud/unauthorised-transaction reporting at custcare.jkb.bank.in, in-app 'Report Fraud'/'Block Digital Channels' under mPay Delight Plus > Services & Requests, and the National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in.

credit.notes: 24-hour helpline. The credit-cards page says to 'notify the lost/stolen Card to the Bank immediately on 24-hour Toll Free Help Line 1800 890 2122' or the 24-hour help desk 0194 2481936 / 0194-2481953 (additional card lines 0194-2482463, 2486424 per the contact page), and that 'The block/Stoplist option for Credit Cards is also available on Mobile Banking Application M-Pay Delight+ of the Bank'; the page also allows notifying the concerned branch/DAC, Corporate Headquarters, M.A. Road, Srinagar, advises reporting loss/theft to police (FIR), and gives nil liability post reporting. Disputes: grievance.creditcards@jkbmail.com, Grievance Redressal Officer +91 194-2713563. Online fraud/unauthorised-transaction reporting: custcare.jkb.bank.in; National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930 (both per the grievance page).
